div.div:
1. Federation thresholds (T-01..T-10) live as versioned data in DynamoDB (never hardcoded on nodes); crop_alert_raised triggers ADR-002 drone confirmation.
2. Episode deduplication: one SMS + push on opening/closure notice; push-only for 24h reminders and resolutions; offline drain coalesced.
3. PII isolation: Threshold Lambda reads zero personal data; only Dispatcher reads KMS personal table for farmer phone and push endpoint.
4. Dashed lines = acknowledgement, async plausibility, offline drain path, or delivery receipt; solid = live synchronous/ingestion path.
